caption:
Claude skills that turn your Claude into a creator studio, comment “skills” for the full install guide 💌

#claudecode #chatgpt #claude #aitips #learnai
author: Cindy Zhu
transcript: Did you know that you can now build an entire creative studio inside of Claude with just 7 skills? So before you spend thousands of dollars and thousands of hours trying to build a creative system that doesn't work, try these. Number 1, Remotion. Connect it with Claude and it adds animations and motion graphics to your video. It can even create full explainer videos on whatever you're working on. Just say what you want and it builds it. No editing needed. Number 2, Competitor Ads Extractor. So this skill pulls live competitor ads, which means all their messaging, hooks and CTAs that are working right now. This one's perfect for competitive research. Number 3, Deep Research. This one's a multi-step agent that runs market analysis in the background while you work. Incredibly helpful for market research. Number 4, Voice DNA. This one extracts your sentence rhythm and vocabulary so that any future copy that Claude writes will sound exactly as if you wrote it. Number 5, 11 Laps. So give it any document and it becomes a narrated audio or like a two-person podcast in like one minute. And number 6, Content Research Writer. Okay, so this one's the full package. It does content research, copywriting and fact checks everything with citations. So overall, five of these are completely free. I think only 11 Laps needs a subscription. Comment skills if you want the full install guide for all five.
title: 7 Claude Skills for a Creator Studio
one_liner: Seven Claude integrations turn the AI into a full creative production and research studio.
key_points: Remotion builds animations and explainer videos directly inside Claude with no editing
Competitor Ads Extractor pulls live rival ad hooks, messaging, and CTAs for research
Voice DNA captures your writing style so Claude's copy sounds authentically like you
ElevenLabs turns any document into a narrated audio or two-person podcast in ~1 minute
